requirements.title: Repository switcher kept in sync with the core repo list
Layered documentation from overview to reference
Present-tense docs with accessible embedded start
Generate architecture and reference pages from registries
Rehome generated docs out of the legacy docs directory
Ecosystem flow diagram with exact names and project marks
Correct ownership and quick start in consumer parity checks
The shared generator must show accessible component package diagrams and export Mermaid source. It must include every spec
Generate API contract docs from the contract registry
Present-tense home page with screenshot and repo map
The spec-delivery page must map specs to implementation references. It must replace the Concepts column
The generator must read Code declarations and existing source citations from spec.md and plan.md
Source declarations must survive status regeneration without adding hand-edited status fields
Each implementation link must identify its source revision and path. External links must remain unverified
The page must state Not mapped when a spec has no code references
The spec table must distinguish implementation, test, and documentation links
The caption must count specs without resolved implementation links
The generator must reject unsafe links and paths outside the checkout. It must retain unresolved mappings
The page must show declared dependencies within and across repositories. It must distinguish references and shared code
Depends-on declarations must resolve local spec and requirement IDs through canonical spec ownership
The generator must distinguish Depends-on, Extends, and References declarations. Mere mentions must not imply prerequisite order
Repository and component groups must include orphan specs. Missing components must remain Unassigned
The page must render package diagrams without browser scripts. Mermaid export must escape source labels
Every relationship must retain its label, source declaration, target link, and evidence limit
The relationship index must retain unresolved targets and specs without declared relationships
Large diagrams must split into navigable groups without hiding any spec or relationship
Three-level drill-down from the ecosystem view to the spec
Add `ecosystem_components()` to `scripts/spec_dashboard_drilldown.py`. It returns the list defined by PIPE-PAGES-R001 (the core repository list) and defines no second list

Define the URL form in `scripts/spec_dashboard_drilldown.py`: level 1 `https://knuckles-team.github.io/<repo>/spec-delivery/`, level 2 `.../spec-delivery/#spec-<ID>`, level 3 row `.../spec-delivery/#req-<ID>`. Add `anchor_for(kind, id)`
Emit the anchors in `spec_row` (`scripts/spec_dashboard_panels.py`): each spec section gets `id="spec-<ID>"` and lists its rows, state, code references, and bound tests; each row gets `id="req-<ID>"`
Link each box in `relation_view` (`scripts/spec_dashboard_relations_view.py`) to `#spec-<ID>` of its own page, or to the other repository's page for a cross-repository node

Cross-repository row, owner `Knuckles-Team/.github` (BLOCKED until that repository carries a spec tree): link each component in `profile/README.md` to `ecosystem_components()` URLs at level 1. Add `scripts/render_profile_links.py` here as the producer
Add `check_drilldown_links(readme, site_index)` to `scripts/spec_dashboard_drilldown.py`. It fails when a component link or spec anchor does not resolve in the generated site
One generator for connectors and client repositories
The reusable workflow `.github/workflows/pages_pipeline.yml` must run the R012 to R014 steps for every caller. It adds no per-repository input and no per-repository copy
agent-webui, agent-terminal-ui, and geniusbot adopt it through the caller pattern in PIPE-CONNSPEC-R004. Each caller change belongs to the repository's own spec
Connectors must inherit code references and relationship views through the shared Pages generator when enabled
Spec-delivery page shows only the current spec state

Remove the `history` field and the `--history-limit` option from `create_snapshot` and `argument_parser` in `scripts/spec_dashboard.py`. The snapshot holds only records read from the current tree, so no ID absent from that tree enters it

Remove `history_panels` and the history and per-commit panels from `scripts/spec_dashboard_render.py`, then delete `scripts/spec_dashboard_charts.py`, `scripts/spec_dashboard_history.py`, `scripts/spec_dashboard_history_metrics.py`, and `scripts/spec_dashboard_history_views.py` with their tests. No state-transition table, chart, metric or panel is rendered
Render only records present in the current `specs/` tree. A requirement ID that was removed in an earlier commit appears nowhere in the HTML
Remove the history scripts from the sparse checkout and the history option from the dashboard call in `.github/workflows/pages_pipeline.yml`. The Pages workflow does not invoke the history modules
Do not render records whose state is `RETIRED`. `read_records` in `scripts/spec_dashboard_sources.py` drops them, so no row, count, legend entry, link, relationship or percentage includes one
The state legend lists exactly three states, `SPECIFIED`, `LANDED` and `VERIFIED`, each with a one-line definition, in `definitions_panel` in `scripts/spec_dashboard_panels.py`
Every record row shows one state cell. The page has no acceptance column, no release column and no second state label
A `delivery_state` outside the three states, after `RETIRED` is filtered, renders as `INVALID` and counts in one visible invalid-state number
Spec delivery is a native menu entry on every documentation site

Add the `spec_delivery` flag to `extra:` in `templates/mkdocs-theme/base.mkdocs.yml` as `!ENV [SPEC_DELIVERY_ENABLED, false]`. Set the variable from `inputs.spec_dashboard_enabled` on the Build Docs step of `.github/workflows/pages_pipeline.yml`
Render a `Spec delivery` link in `templates/mkdocs-theme/overrides/main.html`. The link must use `base_url` and `/spec-delivery/`, and the block must render only when the flag is set

List the `spec-delivery/` page of each repository in a native `<details>` list inside the same navigation landmark. The list must iterate `extra.ecosystem.sites` and must hold no second repository list
Keep every `extra.ecosystem.sites` URL in `templates/mkdocs-theme/base.mkdocs.yml` equal to its `REPOS` entry in `scripts/skill_graph/model.py`

Style the entry in a `<style>` element inside the block in `templates/mkdocs-theme/overrides/main.html` with a visible focus outline. The override is served from the theme checkout through `custom_dir`, so the theme sync check needs no consumer change
The spec-delivery page carries the documentation site's navigation
Add `site_nav(repository)` to `scripts/spec_dashboard_nav.py`. It renders `<nav aria-label="Site">` with the repository name and a `Documentation` link, both to `../`
Mark the current page in `site_nav` with `aria-current="page"` on the `Spec delivery` entry
List every repository in `site_nav` from `ecosystem_components()` in `scripts/spec_dashboard_drilldown.py`. Link each to its level-1 URL and mark the current repository. Define no second list

Add `skip_link()` to `scripts/spec_dashboard_nav.py` and wrap the sheet in `<main id="main">` in `render` in `scripts/spec_dashboard_render.py`. Style the bar with the existing tokens in `scripts/spec_dashboard_style.py`
Add `scripts/spec_dashboard_nav.py` to the sparse checkout in `.github/workflows/pages_pipeline.yml`. The page must keep every existing panel
Documentation claims must match the repository
Test quality gate for repository validation
Scheduled mutation testing reports test gaps
Located structural similarity and extraction guidance
Packaging role-to-extra closure contracts and build gates
User story and artifact schema generation contracts
Specification tooling compatibility and layout standard
Release coordination with multi-phase version-bump policy
Skill-scoped dependency audit and version-update proposal workflow
Project-version reference discovery and code-enhancer binding
Aggregate skill grader call contract and lineage preservation
Package source-path portability and cross-platform legality
Lossless OWL/RDF workflow export-import with version refusal
Installer skill entry binding with supported IDE/agent target matrix
Single-binary portable deployment with zero external-service dependency parity
Stable prompt JSON/Pydantic disk formatting with difference oracle
Unit-test profile with enforced external determinism
Python-only pre-commit hook for ontology governance validation
Complete project test-layout inventory with isolation and order policies
Coverage-decrease refusal in AU proposal and admission
Configured structural limits with named-function failure reporting
One generated architecture explorer, always current
Every scanned repository has a part
The explorer links back to the contribution front door
The explorer states the contribution path in a form a person or an agent finds without guessing
